title: A Puck-informed mode-resolved phase-field fatigue framework for unidirectional composites
summary: Fatigue fracture in unidirectional fibre-reinforced composites is strongly mode dependent: transverse and off-axis cycling is governed by matrix and inter-fibre mechanisms, whereas fibre-aligned cycling activates a longitudinal channel with a higher fracture-energy scale and a different crack topology. Single-damage-variable models can fit global stiffness loss but cannot identify the active mechanism. This work proposes a Puck-informed, mode-resolved phase-field fatigue framework with separate channels for fibre-dominated and matrix/inter-fibre fatigue. Each channel has its own fatigue history, threshold, and resistance-degradation law. Fatigue does not directly degrade elastic stiffness; it lowers the fracture resistance of the active channel, while the corresponding phase field controls stiffness loss and crack-path evolution. The formulation is implemented in Abaqus/Standard using a compact UMAT-UEL architecture with one orthotropic mechanical routine and two scalar phase-field layers. Using one fixed IM7/8552 material and fatigue card, the model is verified through one-element tests, parameter sweeps, and centred-notch and open-hole tension cases at 0, 45, and 90 degrees under monotonic and cyclic loading. Without orientation- or geometry-specific tuning, the framework reproduces transverse matrix/inter-fibre cracking at 90 degrees, off-axis cracking at 45 degrees, and longitudinal matrix splitting with delayed fibre activation at 0 degrees. The fatigue lives follow the expected ordering: 45- and 90-degree cases fail within about 1,000 cycles, while 0-degree cases run out to 200,000 cycles without fibre cracking. Additional load, hole-size, mesh, length-scale, and cycle-block studies confirm consistent crack modes and converged trends. The study is a numerical verification and cross-geometry consistency assessment, not a calibrated experimental life-prediction claim.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Puck理论的模式分辨相场疲劳框架，分别处理纤维主导和基体/纤维间疲劳通道，无需特定调参即可复现不同角度下的疲劳断裂模式与寿命差异。
AI.motivation: 单向纤维增强复合材料的疲劳断裂具有强模式依赖性，现有单损伤变量模型虽能拟合全局刚度损失，但无法区分活跃的疲劳机制（纤维主导 vs. 基体/纤维间）。
AI.method: 提出Puck-informed模式分辨相场疲劳框架，包含纤维主导和基体/纤维间两个独立通道，各具疲劳历史、阈值和抗力退化律；疲劳不直接退化弹性刚度，而是降低断裂抗力，相场控制刚度损失与裂纹路径演化；在Abaqus/Standard中用UMAT-UEL架构实现。
AI.result: 使用固定IM7/8552材料和疲劳卡片，在0°、45°、90°单轴和循环加载下，无需方向或几何特定调参即可复现横/偏轴基体裂纹、纵向基体劈裂及延迟纤维激活；疲劳寿命顺序正确（45°、90°约1000次循环失效，0°达200,000次无纤维断裂）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了模式分辨的疲劳断裂模拟，数值验证和跨几何一致性评估结果良好，但非校准后的实验寿命预测。

title: Parallel simulation of rarefied gas flows on unstructured meshes using the DIG-augmented DSMC method
summary: While the direct simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) is a mainstream stochastic particle method for simulating rarefied gas flows, it incurs excessively high computational costs in the near continuum regime. As a hybrid acceleration approach coupling DSMC with macroscopic synthetic equations, the direct intermittent general synthetic iterative scheme (DIG) delivers fast convergence and asymptotic-preserving characteristics, which effectively alleviate the kinetic scale limitations inherent to standard DSMC. In this study, we develop a parallel DIG augmented DSMC solver for three dimensional rarefied gas flow simulations on unstructured meshes. On top of the standard DSMC algorithms for particle transport and collisions, a reliable intermittent coupling framework is constructed to exchange macroscopic flow data between the stochastic DSMC module and deterministic macroscopic synthetic equations. For parallel execution on unstructured grids, we employ a hybrid MPI architecture equipped with ghost cells to enable local particle tracking and batch inter-rank particle migration. A graph partitioning based dynamic load balancing strategy is also integrated to mitigate uneven particle distribution over computational domains. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed solver achieves satisfactory agreement with the SPARTA DSMC. Leveraging the fast convergence and asymptotic-preserving properties of the DIG method, the required number of spatial cells and statistical sampling steps are drastically decreased, leading to substantial reductions in computational memory and runtime. This work presents an efficient high-performance numerical tool for high-fidelity simulations of rarefied flows over complex geometries. The code is available in the developer repository at the github link.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于直接间歇性广义合成迭代方案（DIG）的并行DSMC求解器，用于三维稀薄气体流动模拟。该求解器在非结构化网格上结合了DSMC与宏观合成方程，采用混合MPI架构和动态负载均衡策略，显著降低了计算内存和运行时间，同时与SPARTA DSMC结果吻合良好。
AI.motivation: DSMC方法在近连续区计算成本过高，需要一种混合加速方法来解决这一瓶颈。DIG方案具有快速收敛和渐近保持特性，能有效缓解标准DSMC的动力学尺度限制。
AI.method: 在标准DSMC粒子输运和碰撞算法基础上，构建间歇性耦合框架交换宏观流场数据；采用混合MPI架构配合虚拟网格实现粒子追踪和跨进程迁移；集成基于图划分的动态负载均衡策略以应对粒子分布不均。
AI.result: 与SPARTA DSMC结果吻合良好；利用DIG方法的快速收敛和渐近保持特性，大幅减少了所需空间网格数和统计采样步数，从而显著降低了计算内存和运行时间。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为复杂几何上的稀薄流高保真模拟提供了一种高效的高性能数值工具，代码已在GitHub开发者仓库开源。

title: Learned Committors as Reaction Coordinates for Nucleation Rates
summary: A central challenge in the analysis of first-order phase transitions is the identification of optimal reaction coordinates. In principle, the committor is the ideal choice; however, its computational cost has historically made it intractable. Here, we train a convolutional neural network ($p_B$-NN) as a proxy for the committor on brute-force committor labels and use it directly as the coordinate of a Markov state model. Applied to magnetisation reversal in the two-dimensional Ising model, $p_B$-NN reproduces brute-force nucleation rates across a range of thermodynamic conditions. The largest geometric cluster size also recovers accurate rates despite providing a poor pointwise predictor of the committor. These results demonstrate that an effective reaction coordinate for nucleation rate calculation must reliably separate the metastable and stable basins, but need not preserve the committor pointwise for every microstate. We stress that this distinction has direct implications for the choice of collective variable in rare-event simulations of nucleation more broadly.

AI.tldr: 本文训练卷积神经网络作为 committor 的代理，用于马尔可夫状态模型的坐标，在二维 Ising 模型磁化反转中成功复现成核速率，并指出有效的反应坐标只需可靠分离亚稳态和稳态盆地，无需逐点精确预测 committor。
AI.motivation: 一阶相变分析中，committor 是理想反应坐标但计算成本极高，亟需高效代理方法。
AI.method: 训练卷积神经网络 (p_B-NN) 作为 committor 的代理，将其直接用作马尔可夫状态模型的坐标。
AI.result: p_B-NN 在二维 Ising 模型磁化反转中复现了多种热力学条件下的成核速率；最大几何簇大小虽点wise 预测 committor 较差，但也能恢复准确速率。
AI.conclusion: 有效的成核反应坐标只需可靠分离亚稳态和稳态盆地，无需逐点精确预测 committor，这对稀有事件模拟中集体变量的选择有直接指导意义。

title: Repurposing acquisition devices into trigger-based timing synchronization of breakdown events during MITICA high voltage holding experiments
summary:
A critical requirement for MITICA -- a full-scale prototype of the heating Neutral Beam Injectors hosted at the Consorzio RFX Neutral Beam Test Facility for the ITER experiment -- is the capability to withstand a continuous voltage of 1MV across the vacuum gaps insulating the beam source from the grounded vessel. To validate such feature, a dedicated voltage-holding test campaign was conducted throughout 2024 and 2025 using a full-scale mock-up of the beam source. The tests also involved an accurate characterization of the associated breakdown events: vacuum dielectric failures which result in rapid potential drops and generate strong current discharges.
  This contribution will present a relative time reconstruction architecture based on cost-effective, embedded RedPitaya (Zynq-7000 FPGA) devices repurposed as timing hubs. These nodes function as configurable trigger multiplexers while simultaneously recording trigger signals as transients to facilitate the offline reconstruction of event sequences. The method allows self-calibration through measuring the static intrinsic delays of the optical fibers and internal logics, generating delay offsets to synchronize acquired waveforms across a sparse, connected-graph topology of both acquisition devices and hubs themselves.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种基于低成本RedPitaya (Zynq-7000 FPGA) 设备的时间重构架构，用于重建MITICA中性束注入器1MV真空耐压测试中击穿事件的时间序列，通过自校准光纤和内部门控延迟实现跨稀疏连接拓扑的波形同步。
AI.motivation: MITICA全尺寸中性束注入器原型需要承受1MV连续电压以验证绝缘性能，2024-2025年进行的耐压测试中产生大量真空击穿事件（快速电位跌落和强电流放电），需要精确重建这些事件的时间序列以便分析故障原因。
AI.method: 采用低成本嵌入式RedPitaya (Zynq-7000 FPGA) 设备作为定时枢纽节点，兼具可配置触发多路复用器和瞬态触发信号记录功能；通过测量光纤和内部门控的静态固有延迟生成偏移量，实现稀疏连接图拓扑中采集设备与枢纽节点间的自校准波形同步。
AI.result: 实现了击穿事件序列的离线重建，通过自校准方式补偿光纤和逻辑延迟，在稀疏连接图拓扑中完成多设备波形的时间同步。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于低成本FPGA的分布式时间重构架构能有效满足MITICA 1MV耐压测试中真空击穿事件的时间同步和序列重建需求，为大型聚变实验装置的高压绝缘验证提供了一种经济可行的时序测量方案。

title: Universality and Dynamical Inequivalence in Isospectral Non-Hermitian Anderson Transitions
summary: The Hatano Nelson paradigm establishes that extensive bulk nonreciprocity can destabilize Anderson localization via an imaginary gauge flux. Here, we demonstrate that extensive nonreciprocity is not a necessary ingredient: a single non-Hermitian boundary bond in a disordered one-dimensional ring suffices to drive the localization-delocalization transition. More generally, we construct an exactly isospectral family of non-Hermitian Hamiltonians that continuously interpolates between the uniform Hatano Nelson model and the single-bond limit. We show that the universal critical behavior encompassing spectral, eigenstate, and topological diagnostics is gauge invariant and governed solely by the total imaginary gauge flux, regardless of its spatial distribution. Remarkably, despite sharing identical spectra and critical exponents, different configurations within this isospectral family exhibit qualitatively distinct quantum dynamics, establishing a fundamental separation between static and dynamical universality in non-Hermitian systems. Specifically, the single boundary realization features rapid operator scrambling, oscillatory wavepacket acceleration, and a double re-entrant steady state entanglement transition. Finally, we propose an experimentally feasible realization based on multi-terminal topological transport, providing a realistic route toward observing boundary induced non Hermitian criticality and its unconventional dynamical signatures.

AI.tldr: 本文发现非厄米边界单键就足以驱动无序环中的局域-退局域转变，并构建了与均匀Hatano-Nelson模型等谱的哈密顿量族，揭示了静态与动力学普适性的根本分离。
AI.motivation: 传统Hatano-Nelson范式认为体相大范围非互易性（imaginary gauge flux）是破坏安德森局域化的必要条件。作者质疑这一条件是否必须，探索仅靠边界单个非厄米键能否驱动局域化-退局域化转变。
AI.method: 构造了与均匀Hatano-Nelson模型精确等谱的非厄米哈密顿量族，该族连续插值于均匀模型与单边界键极限之间；结合谱分析、本征态诊断和拓扑不变量进行普适临界行为分析；通过动力学模拟（算符 scrambling、波包加速、纠缠熵）对比不同构型。
AI.result: (1) 单个非厄米边界键足以驱动局域化-退局域化转变；(2) 临界行为（谱、本征态、拓扑）由总imaginary gauge flux唯一决定，具有规范不变性；(3) 等谱族内不同构型显现截然不同的动力学行为：单边界实现呈现快速算符 scrambling、振荡波包加速和双重返稳态纠缠相变；(4) 提出了基于多端拓扑输运的实验方案。
AI.conclusion: 非厄米系统中静态临界性质与动力学普适性可以完全分离，边界效应足以取代体相非互易性成为驱动非厄米相变的核心机制，为实验实现非厄米临界现象提供了可行路径。

title: Parity Anomaly of Preformed Pairs Governs the Thermal Hall Effect above $T_c$
summary: A large negative thermal Hall signal has been reported across multiple cuprate families in the pseudogap phase where the superconducting order parameter has vanished, with a magnitude that no existing microscopic theory reproduces without free parameters. Competing proposals based on chiral phonons, spinons, or loop currents each require undetermined coupling constants and do not predict the temperature dependence in terms of an independently measured spectroscopic gap. We show that the parity anomaly of $(2+1)$-dimensional quantum field theory resolves this long-standing puzzle: the preformed-pair pseudogap $Δ_{\rm pg}(T)$ enters the parity-odd fermion determinant identically to a condensate mass, yielding the exact parameter-free formula $κ_{xy}/T = (π^2 k_B^2/6h)\,C\,\tanh[Δ_{\rm pg}(T)/(2k_BT)]$, where $C$ is the Chern number of the chiral pairing channel and $Δ_{\rm pg}(T)$ is directly measurable by ARPES or STM. Coleman-Hill non-renormalization protects the result against higher-loop corrections, and two independent numerical tests, Wilson-loop flux threading and DMRG on $p+ip$ cylinders, confirm the anomaly correlation length to $0.2\%$ accuracy with no power-law finite-size corrections. The theory predicts thermal Hall onset at $T^*$ rather than $T_c$, provides a falsifiable logarithmic-derivative test against ARPES data, and yields a concrete quantitative target for magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene.

AI.tldr: 本文提出量子场论的奇偶性异常（parity anomaly）可以解释铜氧化物赝能隙相中巨大的负热霍尔信号，推导出无自由参数的精确公式κ_xy/T = (π²k_B²/6h)·C·tanh[Δ_pg(T)/(2k_BT)]，其中Δ_pg(T)可由ARPES或STM独立测量得到，Coleman-Hill非重整化定理保证了结果不受高阶修正影响，两个独立数值检验（Wilson环通量穿刺和p+ip圆柱的DMRG）验证了异常关联长度精度达0.2%。
AI.motivation: 铜氧化物在赝能隙相中观测到巨大的负热霍尔效应，现有微观理论均需引入自由参数才能拟合，且无法用独立测量的能隙预测温度依赖关系，该问题长期未被解决。
AI.method: 利用(2+1)维量子场论的奇偶性异常，将预配对赝能隙Δ_pg(T)等同于凝聚质量（condensate mass）进入奇宇称费米子行列式，结合Coleman-Hill非重整化定理保证结果的普适性，并通过Wilson环数值验证和DMRG模拟p+ip圆柱进行双重检验。
AI.result: 推导出无自由参数的热霍尔电导率公式，精确匹配数值实验（精度0.2%），预测热霍尔信号在T*（赝能隙温度）而非T_c（超导转变温度）处开启，提供了可用ARPES数据验证的对数导数检验方法，并可为魔角扭曲双层石墨烯提供定量预测目标。
AI.conclusion: 奇偶性异常机制成功解释了铜氧化物赝能隙相的热霍尔效应，无需任何自由参数，理论预测可直接通过现有实验手段进行检验，并可能推广到其他强关联量子材料体系。

title: Atomistic Modeling for Electro-chemical Reactions
summary: Computational modeling plays a central role in advancing our understanding of electro-chemical reactions and may thus guide the rational development of sustainable energy technologies. Despite significant methodological progress, achieving predictive and quantitatively reliable simulations of electrified solid-liquid interfaces under operando conditions remains a major challenge. Recently, the European COST Action EU-CONCERT (EUropean COllaborative Network on electroCatalysis for Efficient Renewable Technologies) was launched with the aim of advancing atomistic modeling of electrochemical reactions through systematic benchmarking and cross-validation. This position paper outlines the consortium's view of the current state of the art, identifies the priority methodological challenges to be addressed, and defines the benchmark tests that are urgently needed. This paper should serve as a guide to the community and a roadmap for the EU-CONCERT COST Action.

AI.tldr: 本文概述了欧盟COST Action EU-CONCERT联盟对电化学界面原子建模现状的共识，识别了优先方法学挑战，并定义了亟需的基准测试，旨在作为社区指南和行动路线图。
AI.motivation: 计算建模对理解电化学反应和指导可持续能源技术开发至关重要，但实现操作条件下带电固液界面的预测性和定量可靠模拟仍是重大挑战。
AI.method: 通过欧洲COST Action EU-CONCERT联盟，采用系统基准测试和交叉验证的方法，推进电化学反应原子建模。
AI.result: 形成了联盟对当前技术现状的共识，识别了优先方法学挑战，并定义了亟需的基准测试。
AI.conclusion: 本文旨在为社区提供指导，并为EU-CONCERT COST Action提供路线图。

title: Second-harmonic signal in electric-field-modulated EPR spectra of Fe3 spin triangles
summary: We present electric-field-modulated electron paramagnetic resonance (EFM-EPR) measurements on centrosymmetric single crystals of the molecular spin triangle $\mathrm{[{Fe_3}O({O_2}CPh){_6}(py){_3}]ClO{_4}{\cdot}py}$ ($\bf{Fe_3}$). We provide the first observation of second harmonic EFM-EPR signal in polynuclear magnetic molecules. This signal is simulated and explained in terms of an electric-field induced modulation of the isotropic exchange in the molecule, and of their symmetry lowering resulting from a Jahn-Teller effect. Additionally, an unexpected first harmonic EFM-EPR signal is observed. Various plausible symmetry-breaking mechanisms are discussed in an attempt to explain this feature, whose observation is unexpected in a nominally centrosymmetric crystal.

AI.tldr: 该研究在中心对称的Fe₃分子三角晶体中实现了电场调制的电子顺磁共振(EFM-EPR)测量，首次在多核分子磁体中观察到二次谐波EFM-EPR信号，并通过电场诱导的各向同性交换调制和Jahn-Teller效应导致的对称性降低来解释该现象。同时观察到意外的一次谐波信号，并探讨了多种对称性破缺机制。
AI.motivation: 探索电场如何调控多核分子磁体中的自旋相互作用，特别是在中心对称体系中验证电场-自旋耦合的可能性。
AI.method: 在中心对称单晶[Fe₃O(O₂CPh)₆(py)₃]ClO₄·py (Fe₃)上开展电场调制EPR实验，分析一次和二次谐波信号，结合理论模拟解释电场诱导的各向同性交换调制及Jahn-Teller效应。
AI.result: 首次在多核分子磁体中观测到二次谐波EFM-EPR信号；意外观察到本不应出现在中心对称晶体中的一次谐波EFM-EPR信号。
AI.conclusion: 电场可通过调制各向同性交换耦合影响分子磁体的自旋性质，Jahn-Teller效应可导致对称性降低；一次谐波的出现暗示中心对称假设可能存在局限性，需进一步探讨对称性破缺机制。

title: Seven- and eight-loop critical exponents of the three-dimensional Ising model
summary: We determine the critical exponents $η$, $ν$, and the correction-to-scaling exponent $ω$ of the three-dimensional Ising universality class by resumming the recently computed seven- and eight-loop renormalization-group series in the $ε=4-d$ expansion (O.~Schnetz, \textit{Phys. Rev. D} \textbf{97}, 085018 (2018); O.~Schnetz, \textit{Phys. Rev. D} \textbf{107}, 036002 (2023)). The resummation combines conformal mapping with a homographic transformation, while the resummation parameters are optimized according to two complementary criteria. This approach yields precise estimates of the critical exponents together with quantitative uncertainty estimates. We find that the error bar on $η$ decreases rapidly with increasing loop order, whereas this is the case neither for $ν$ nor for $ω$. Unexpectedly, although the estimated values are accurate in absolute terms, their slow convergence with the loop order leads to a slight but systematic tension with the conformal bootstrap estimates that are currently considered as the benchmark. We discuss several possible origins of this behavior and its implications for high-order resummations of perturbative renormalization-group series.

AI.tldr: 本文通过重求和七圈和八圈的微扰重整化群级数，结合共形映射与单应变换，优化了重求和参数，精确估计了三维Ising普适类临界指数η、ν和ω，发现η的误差随圈数增加而快速减小，但ν和ω并非如此，且结果与共形bootstrap基准存在轻微但系统的张力。
AI.motivation: 旨在利用最新计算的高阶（七圈和八圈）ε展开级数，通过改进的重求和技术获得更精确的三维Ising普适类临界指数，并考察高阶级数收敛性及其与共形bootstrap结果的潜在偏差。
AI.method: 采用结合共形映射（conformal mapping）与单应变换（homographic transformation）的重求和方案，并依据两个互补的优化准则确定重求和参数。
AI.result: η的误差随圈数增加快速下降，而ν和ω的收敛较慢；估计值在绝对意义上准确，但与共形bootstrap基准结果存在轻微系统张力。
AI.conclusion: 指出高阶微扰级数的收敛行为存在非平凡差异，讨论了可能导致系统偏差的原因及其对微扰重整化群级数高阶重求和的启示。

title: Anisotropic vacancy-induced magnetization textures in altermagnets
summary: We study magnetic textures induced by vacancies in altermagnets using microscopic simulations and low-energy field theory. We show that a vacancy generically produces a real-space anisotropic distortion of the magnetic order, whose structure encodes the symmetry of the underlying altermagnetic state. This impurity response offers a direct route to detecting altermagnetic order with locally resolved probes. We demonstrate this for both classical altermagnets, where vacancies generate anisotropic magnetization textures in a transverse magnetic field, and quantum models, where fluctuations induce longitudinal power-law decaying magnetic distortions even at zero field.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微观模拟和低能场论，研究了反铁磁体（altermagnets）中空位诱导的磁纹理，发现空位会产生各向异性的磁序畸变，其结构编码了反铁磁态对称性，为利用局域探针检测反铁磁序提供了直接途径。
AI.motivation: 探索空位缺陷如何影响反铁磁体中的磁序结构，并利用这种缺陷响应来检测反铁磁序。
AI.method: 采用微观模拟和低能场论相结合的方法，分别研究经典反铁磁体和量子模型中的空位诱导磁纹理。
AI.result: 空位会各向异性地扭曲磁序，其结构编码了反铁磁态的对称性；经典模型中空位在横向磁场中产生各向异性磁化纹理；量子模型中即使在零场下，涨落也会诱导纵向幂律衰减的磁畸变。
AI.conclusion: 空位诱导的磁纹理可作为检测反铁磁序的有效手段，为局域探针实验提供了理论依据。

title: Bulk Boundary Condition for Surface Calculations in Density Functional Theory
summary: We present a bulk boundary condition formalism for surface calculations in Kohn--Sham density functional theory. The approach exploits the nearsightedness of electronic interactions in real space to restrict the calculation to a localized surface region. Within this region, the electron density is evaluated by leveraging the decay of the density matrix, with bulk values imposed on the density and electrostatic potential in the interior, and the electrostatic potential solved subject to bulk boundary conditions. The energy and atomic forces are computed using density-matrix-based expressions. Through representative calculations of surface and adsorption energies, we demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed formalism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于体相边界条件的表面计算形式，利用电子相互作用的近视性和密度矩阵的衰减特性，将Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论计算限制在局部表面区域，通过体相值约束内部电子密度和静电势，实现了表面和吸附能的高效准确计算。
AI.motivation: 传统表面DFT计算需要包含大量体相原子层，计算成本高。作者希望利用电子相互作用的"近视性"（nearsightedness）将计算限制在表面局部区域，同时保持计算精度，从而降低计算开销。
AI.method: 1) 利用实空间中电子相互作用的近视性，将计算限制在局部表面区域；2) 利用密度矩阵的衰减性质评估该区域内的电子密度；3) 在内部区域对电子密度和静电势施加体相值约束；4) 在体相边界条件下求解静电势；5) 采用基于密度矩阵的表达式计算能量和原子力。
AI.result: 通过表面能和吸附能的代表性计算，证明了所提出形式在精度和效率上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该体相边界条件形式能够在保持计算精度的同时，显著降低表面DFT计算的成本，为表面和界面性质的高效研究提供了新的理论工具。

title: Bogolyubov excitons as a microscopic origin of two-level systems
summary: Two-level systems (TLS) are a leading source of decoherence and dielectric loss in Josephson-junction qubits, yet their microscopic origin remains unresolved. We propose an intrinsic, purely electronic TLS candidate: subgap bound states of Bogolyubov quasiparticles. We show that, in a model of a conventional superconductor with electron-electron attraction in the $s$-wave channel and repulsion in higher-angular-momentum channels, the latter produce an effective attraction between Bogolyubov quasiparticles, forming bound states. These Bogolyubov excitons resemble Bardasis--Schrieffer excitons but are driven by repulsive interactions. Bulk Bogolyubov excitons are not easily detectable through single-particle tunneling or other conventional probes, but we show that surface excitons couple to an external electric field and behave as two-level systems. We examine an idealized model of a bulk superconductor proximity-coupled to a two-dimensional repulsive metal, which could represent an external metallic or semiconductor layer or an underscreened region of the superconductor. The two levels correspond to the absence and presence of a single exciton, which carries an electric dipole moment and exhibits an avoided crossing with a resonator, as observed for TLS. Because this mechanism requires no defects and cannot be eliminated by screening or annealing, it suggests that TLS-like excitations may be intrinsic to superconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全新的、纯电子的两能级系统（TLS）候选机制：超导体中Bogolyubov准粒子的亚隙束缚态（Bogolyubov激子），由排斥相互作用驱动形成，能解释约瑟夫森结量子比特中的退相干和介电损耗问题。
AI.motivation: 两能级系统（TLS）是约瑟夫森结量子比特退相干和介电损耗的主要来源，但其微观起源一直不明。现有解释多归因于缺陷，但缺乏实验验证，因此需要寻找新的内在机制。
AI.method: 通过构建常规超导体模型，在s波通道中引入电子-电子吸引，在高角动量通道中引入排斥相互作用，证明排斥作用会产生Bogolyubov准粒子之间的有效吸引，形成束缚态（Bogolyubov激子）。进一步分析了表面激子与外部电场的耦合行为，以及将超导体与二维排斥性金属近邻耦合的理想化模型。
AI.result: 1. 高角动量通道的排斥相互作用可以驱动Bogolyubov准粒子形成束缚态（类似Bardasis-Schrieffer激子）；2. 体相Bogolyubov激子不易通过常规探测量子隧穿探测到；3. 表面激子能与外部电场耦合，表现为两能级系统（TLS）：两个能级分别对应激子的不存在和存在，携带电偶极矩，与谐振器发生避免交叉。
AI.conclusion: 该机制不需要缺陷，也无法通过屏蔽或退火消除，表明TLS类激发可能是超导体的内禀属性，为理解量子比特退相干提供了全新视角。

title: Coherent vibrational wave packet motion in ErCry4a proteins monitors the redox state of the flavin chromophore
summary: Cryptochromes are blue-light-sensitive flavoproteins that play central roles in biological function. In European robin (Erithacus rubecula) ErCry4a proteins, optical excitation of their flavin chromophore forms a long-lived radical pair through a sequence of electron transfer steps across a tetradic chain of tryptophan residues, making them primary candidates for magnetoreception in night migratory songbirds. Recent quantum chemical calculations indicate that nonadiabatic couplings play a central role in the energy and charge transfer processes initiated by optical excitation. Here, we study these dynamics in ErCry4a using ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy with 10-fs time resolution in the 450-nm spectral range. We uncover a rapid, sub-50 fs red shift in stimulated emission, quenched within 360 fs by electron transfer from a nearby tryptophan moiety. While high-frequency excited state vibrations are rapidly damped, coherent motion involving several low-frequency vibrations persists during both the initial energy relaxation and the subsequent electron transfer. This is evidenced by probing the coherent vibrational motion of the formed FAD$^{\bullet-}$ radical anion and is independently validated by blocking the electron transfer through site-selective tryptophan mutation. Our results only provide insight into the role of nonadiabatic couplings for the initial steps of cryptochrome photoactivation and suggest a general strategy for redox-state-specific monitoring of charge transfer dynamics by probing coherent vibrational motion.

AI.tldr: 本文利用10飞秒时间分辨的超快瞬态吸收光谱技术，研究了欧洲知更鸟ErCry4a隐花色素蛋白中由光激发引发的超快动力学过程，发现受激发射在50飞秒内发生红移、360飞秒内被电子转移猝灭，并观测到低频相干振动在能量弛豫和电子转移过程中持续存在，揭示了非绝热耦合在隐花色素光激活初始步骤中的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 隐花色素是鸟类磁感应候选蛋白，其光激发后通过色氨酸四联体链的电子转移形成长寿命自由基对，但非绝热耦合在初始能量和电荷转移过程中的作用尚不明确，需要实验证据来验证理论计算结果。
AI.method: 采用10飞秒时间分辨率的超快瞬态吸收光谱技术，在450 nm光谱范围研究ErCry4a蛋白的动力学过程，并通过位点选择性色氨酸突变阻断电子转移作为对照实验。
AI.result: 发现受激发射在50飞秒内发生快速红移，360飞秒内被色氨酸电子转移猝灭；高频振动快速衰减，但低频相干振动在能量弛豫和电子转移过程中持续存在，并观测到FAD$^{\bullet-}$自由基阴离子的相干振动。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果揭示了非绝热耦合在隐花色素光激活初始步骤中的重要作用，并提出了一种通过探测相干振动来监测电荷转移动力学的氧化还原态特异性通用策略。

title: Quantum Dot Moiré from Crossed MoS2 Nanoribbons
summary: Twisted atomically thin layers have attracted much attention for Moiré potential and correlated quantum phenomena. However, existing Moiré superlattices have largely been limited to extensive wavefunction without lateral confinement. Here we introduce a new platform where 1D nanoribbons of 2D MoS2 grown by vapor deposition can be easily superposed at various angles from stacking and transferring, to form Moiré quantum dots at their intersections with unique exciton physics. Angle-dependent Moiré intersections show enhanced exciton emission at commensurate angle 22 deg, which demonstrates faster relaxation at the cryogenic temperature. A size-dependent study further exhibits a reduced exciton energy and soften out-of-plane interlayer coupling for smaller Moiré areas. Our results reveal exciton physics turnability via precise overlapping of 1D nanoribbons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新平台：通过堆叠和转移化学气相沉积生长的1D MoS2纳米带，在交叉点形成Moiré量子点，实现了角度依赖的激子物理调控，特别是在22°共度角处观察到增强的激子发射和更快的弛豫过程。
AI.motivation: 现有Moiré超晶格大多局限于无横向约束的扩展波函数，缺乏对激子物理的局域调控能力。作者希望引入一种具有横向约束的新型Moiré平台。
AI.method: 采用化学气相沉积生长1D MoS2纳米带，通过堆叠和转移技术在不同角度下叠加形成Moiré量子点，并进行角度依赖和尺寸依赖的光学表征。
AI.result: 在22°共度角处观察到增强的激子发射和更快的低温弛豫；更小的Moiré区域导致激子能量降低和面外层间耦合软化。
AI.conclusion: 通过精确重叠1D纳米带可实现激子物理的可调性，为Moiré量子点研究提供了新平台。

title: Fluctuation theorems for autonomous work
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. Published with Open Access on Dec. 12, 2025, in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (USA). This version contains the published article together with the published Supporting Information
summary: Classical fluctuation theorems for work have been obtained theoretically, and verified experimentally, within a non-autonomous framework in which work is performed on a system of interest, ${\cal S}$, by the external manipulation of a work parameter, such as a piston's position. Here we obtain fluctuation theorems within an autonomous framework in which ${\cal S}$ exchanges energy with a reversible work source, ${\cal R}$. The two subsystems, ${\cal R}$ and ${\cal S}$, interact with one another as they evolve under Hamiltonian or stochastic dynamics, without external intervention. In this setting, we must account for the back-action of ${\cal S}$ on ${\cal R}$, which is absent in the non-autonomous setting. We obtain autonomous versions of standard fluctuation theorems for work and entropy production. In each case, we argue, the autonomous fluctuation theorem reduces to its non-autonomous counterpart when ${\cal R}$'s inertia becomes infinitely large.

AI.tldr: 本文将经典功涨落定理从非自治框架扩展至自治框架，其中系统与可逆功源自发相互作用，无需外部操控。推导了功与熵产生的自治涨落定理，并证明在功源惯性趋于无穷大时，自治定理可还原为非自治形式。
AI.motivation: 经典功涨落定理仅在非自治框架（系统受外部操控）下被验证，但真实物理过程常是自治的（系统与功源自发相互作用）。作者旨在填补自治框架下涨落定理的理论空白，并考虑系统对功源的反作用。
AI.method: 采用哈密顿动力学和随机动力学两种框架，构建系统S与可逆功源R的自发相互作用模型，推导自治版本的工作涨落定理和熵产生涨落定理，并通过极限分析（R惯性无穷大）与非自治版本建立联系。
AI.result: 成功推导出自治框架下的功涨落定理和熵产生涨落定理；证明了当功源R的惯性趋于无穷大时，自治涨落定理退化为经典的非自治形式。
AI.conclusion: 自治涨落定理为理解无外部干预的能量交换过程提供了统一理论基础，揭示了非自治理论是自治理论在功源惯性极大时的极限情形，拓展了涨落定理的适用范围。

title: Electron-Phonon Functional Renormalization Group of Fermi Liquid Instabilities
summary: We formulate a functional renormalization group (FRG) ansatz for correlated electron models that incorporates electronic interactions as well as electron-phonon coupling (EPC) stemming from dispersive phonon bands. Particularizing to the RG flow of the electron-electron interaction vertex, we treat phonon- and electron-mediated Fermi liquid instabilities on equal footing as we analyze tentative electronic order parameters related to charge, spin, nematicity, and superconducting pairing. We illustrate the approach at the example of Peierls-type transitions we find for the Hubbard model on the square lattice coupled to acoustic phonon bands. Our method allows to incorporate full electronic and phononic ab initio input, and thus lends itself to the analysis of electronic order from intertwined electronic interactions and EPC at a microscopically most substantiated level.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种功能重整化群（FRG）方法，将电子相互作用和电子-声子耦合（EPC）统一处理，用于分析关联电子模型中的费米液体不稳定性，并以方格子Hubbard模型耦合声学声子带中的Peierls型相变为例进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以同时处理电子相互作用和电子-声子耦合导致的竞争性有序相，亟需一种将二者平等纳入的理论框架。
AI.method: 扩展FRG方法，将色散声子带引入重整化群流，在电子-电子相互作用顶点流中同时考虑声子介导和电子介导的费米液体不稳定性。
AI.result: 以方格子Hubbard模型耦合声学声子带为例，成功发现了Peierls型相变，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可结合完整的电子和声子第一性原理输入，为在微观层面上分析电子相互作用与EPC交织导致的电子有序态提供了有力工具。

title: Axion-Induced Casimir Interaction Between Graphene Plates
summary: Axion dark matter may induce observable electromagnetic effects in resonant cavity systems and potentially lead to modifications of the Casimir interaction. In this context, graphene represents an attractive platform owing to its tunable electromagnetic properties, and the fact that its electromagnetic response can be modelled microscopically from first principles within quantum field theory. The electromagnetic response induced by axion dark matter is investigated in a planar cavity consisting of parallel graphene interfaces in the presence of a homogeneous external magnetic field, incorporating finite temperature, chemical potential and dissipation through the graphene conductivity. Closed analytical expressions are obtained for the induced electric field and the resulting pressure. The pressure exhibits resonant enhancement at a series of plate separations satisfying $d_n=(2πn-φ(r))/m_a$, where $m_a$ is the axion mass and the phase $φ(r)$ is determined by the reflection coefficient $r$, which depends on the graphene conductivity evaluated at $ω=m_a$. The resonant structure is strongly influenced by the graphene chemical potential and damping parameter. In particular, increased doping, for example via a gate voltage, sharpens the resonances and amplifies the axion-induced signal. By comparing the resonantly enhanced signal with the conventional Casimir background, the parametric regimes in which the effect could become experimentally relevant are identified, with the strongest sensitivity obtained for highly doped low-dissipation graphene configurations operated near resonance. These results demonstrate that graphene-based Casimir-type configurations may provide a sensitive framework for probing axion-induced electromagnetic phenomena and highlight the interplay between axion electrodynamics, cavity resonances, and material properties in low-dimensional systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在平行石墨烯界面构成的平面腔中，轴子暗物质在外部磁场作用下诱发的电磁效应。通过解析表达式揭示了共振增强的压力信号，发现石墨烯的化学势和阻尼参数会显著影响共振结构，高掺杂低耗散的石墨烯配置在共振条件下可实现对轴子信号的最强探测灵敏度。
AI.motivation: 探究轴子暗物质在谐振腔系统中可能产生的可观测电磁效应，并利用石墨烯可调谐的电磁特性及可从第一性原理建模的优势，为暗物质探测提供新的实验平台。
AI.method: 在平行石墨烯界面平面腔中引入均匀外磁场，基于量子场论微观建模石墨烯电导率（考虑有限温度、化学势和耗散），推导轴子诱导电场和压力的闭合解析表达式，分析共振条件及材料参数影响。
AI.result: 获得轴子诱导电场和压力的解析解；压力在板间距满足$d_n=(2πn-φ(r))/m_a$时出现共振增强；石墨烯化学势增大和高掺杂使共振峰更尖锐、信号更强；通过与Casimir背景对比，确定了可实验观测的参数区间。
AI.conclusion: 石墨烯基Casimir型腔体可作为探测轴子诱导电磁现象的灵敏平台，揭示了轴子电动力学、腔共振与低维材料性质之间的相互作用机制。

title: Bond, orbital and spin order in d4/d6/d7 perovskite oxides: successes and limitations of foundation interatomic potentials
summary: Foundation machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are rapidly replacing density-functional theory (DFT) for modeling structure and nuclear dynamics, making their fidelity in strongly correlated systems an urgent question. We test three foundation potentials on the low-temperature order of three correlated, isostructural ABO3 perovskite oxides: LaMnO3 (d4), LaCoO3 (d6), and NdNiO3 (d7). We run molecular dynamics for 1 ns on 80- and 160-atom supercells from 50 to 300 K with no system-specific training. These oxides expose three distinct classes of low-temperature order that define a hierarchy of difficulty for the potentials. The scalar class, represented by NdNiO3, has a simple geometric fingerprint and is captured. The vector class, represented by LaMnO3, requires identifying which Cartesian axis carries the long bond at each site, and is captured in magnitude but not in symmetry. The on-site class, represented by the low-spin to high-spin crossover in LaCoO3, is a purely local multiplet population shift with no spatial order parameter and remains inaccessible to present-day MLIPs.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了三种基础机器学习原子间势能（MLIPs）在强关联ABO3钙钛矿氧化物（LaMnO3、LaCoO3、NdNiO3）低温相中的表现，发现它们能捕捉标量序（NdNiO3），能捕捉矢量序的强度但无法正确区分对称性（LaMnO3），而完全无法描述局域自旋态转变（LaCoO3）。
AI.motivation: 随着基础MLIPs快速取代DFT用于结构和核动力学建模，评估它们在强关联体系中的保真度成为迫切问题。
AI.method: 在80和160原子超胞上，从50K到300K运行1 ns分子动力学模拟，无体系特定训练，测试三种基础势能对三种等结构ABO3钙钛矿氧化物的表现。
AI.result: 三种氧化物展现了不同难度层次的低温序：NdNiO3（标量类）的几何指纹简单，MLIPs能够捕捉；LaMnO3（矢量类）能捕捉序的大小但无法正确反映对称性；LaCoO3（在位类）的低自旋到高自旋转变完全无法被现有MLIPs描述。
AI.conclusion: 基础MLIPs在处理强关联体系时存在根本性局限，尤其是涉及局域电子多重组态（如自旋态转变）时，需要新方法突破。

title: Observation of giant nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching in superconductor-ferromagnet hybrids
summary: Magneto-thermal switch is a crucial thermal component which enables heat transfer control by the application of an external magnetic field. Recently, a nonvolatile behavior in magneto-thermal conductivity at zero magnetic field was observed in type-II and phase-separated superconductors owing to magnetic flux pinning nature, leading to an energy-efficient thermal control technology. However, the nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching ratio has been much lower than the volatile one in conventional materials. Here, we demonstrate a giant nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching in ferromagnetic Fe-superconducting Pb hybrids. The dispersion of pure Fe particles realizes increased electron and decreased phonon contributions in the thermal conductivity, which enhances the magneto-thermal switching ratio at the superconducting-to-normal conducting phase transition. Furthermore, in concert with trapped magnetic flux by supercurrent, ferromagnetic moment of Fe breaks the superconductivity of Pb matrix at zero magnetic field, enabling a significantly large nonvolatility even with a slight amount of Fe inclusions. Consequently, the nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching ratio reaches 719% in maximum at the Fe ratio of 8.7 vol%, which is more than twice the previous record value observed in Pb-Sn composites and the volatile one in pure Pb. This work broadens the exploration space and strategy for giant nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching materials.

AI.tldr: 研究者在铁磁性Fe-超导Pb混合材料中实现了719%的巨大非易失性磁热开关比，远超此前纪录，通过Fe颗粒分散调控电子和声子热导，并结合铁磁矩与磁通钉扎实现零磁场下的非易失性。
AI.motivation: 非易失性磁热开关在零磁场下仍能保持热导状态，具有节能潜力，但此前非易失性开关比远低于易失性材料，亟需提升开关性能。
AI.method: 在超导Pb基体中分散纯Fe铁磁颗粒，利用Fe颗粒增加电子热导贡献、降低声子热导贡献，并借助Fe的铁磁矩与超导电流捕获的磁通协同作用，在零磁场下破坏Pb基体的超导态，实现非易失性。
AI.result: 当Fe体积比为8.7%时，非易失性磁热开关比达到719%，是此前Pb-Sn复合材料纪录值的两倍以上，也超过纯Pb的易失性开关比。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为开发巨非易失性磁热开关材料提供了新的探索空间和策略。

title: Reaction-network reasoning with frontier models for experimentally confirmed catalyst-selectivity hypotheses
summary: Catalysts are essential for sustainable chemical manufacturing, yet discovering novel architectures remains a bottleneck dominated by trial-and-error experimentation and computationally intensive screening. In complex reactions such as electrochemical carbon dioxide reduction, product selectivity is governed by dynamic interfacial, electrolyte, and potential factors as well as kinetic pathway competition. Conventional descriptor-based machine learning and computational potentials struggle to resolve these mechanistic branch points, primarily relying on static ground-state descriptors or bulk structural correlations rather than end-to-end topological pathway analysis. Here, we show that frontier language models, when strictly constrained to reason over explicit reaction networks, can discover novel catalysts by identifying the physical levers that govern pathway competition. We developed a human-AI co-thinking framework that enforces network invariance to extract testable hypotheses from complex chemical graphs. Applied to CO2 electroreduction, the framework identified ketene desorption and hydroxide capture as the acetate-forming pathway, and predicted a distinct adsorbed CO and CH2 coupling route to ketene. By isolating actionable control levers, specifically local alkalinity, controlled iron incorporation, and restricted interfacial proton-donor accessibility, the framework guided the prospective synthesis of a copper-iron oxide catalyst demonstrating a threefold increase in acetate selectivity over matched Cu-rich baselines. This mechanism-guided reasoning architecture shifts the computational paradigm from retrospective statistical prediction to forward-looking hypothesis generation, providing a broadly applicable blueprint for mechanism-guided materials discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种人类-AI协同思考框架，利用前沿语言模型在严格约束下推理显式反应网络，发现CO₂电还原中乙酸生成路径的关键物理杠杆（局部碱度、铁掺入、质子供体可及性），并据此合成了一种铜-铁氧化物催化剂，其乙酸选择性相比铜基线提高了三倍。
AI.motivation: 传统催化剂发现依赖于试错实验和计算筛选，而描述符机器学习和计算势能方法难以解析复杂反应（如CO₂电还原）中的动力学路径分支点。
AI.method: 开发人类-AI协同思考框架，强制语言模型在显式反应网络上推理，通过网络不变性提取可检验假设，识别控制路径竞争的物理杠杆。
AI.result: 该框架识别出乙酸生成路径（烯酮脱附+氢氧根捕获），预测了吸附CO与CH₂偶联生成烯酮的路线，并指导合成了铜-铁氧化物催化剂，乙酸选择性提升三倍。
AI.conclusion: 该机制导向推理架构将计算范式从回顾性统计预测转向前瞻性假设生成，为机制导向的材料发现提供了广泛适用的蓝图。

title: Equilibrium in a Reaction Network of Assemblies
summary: We study a mean-field reaction network whose species are assemblies built from identical atoms by reversible coagulation and fragmentation. Each assembly is an ordered binary tree, so the number of species of a given length grows combinatorially, as the Catalan numbers. The model nonetheless admits an explicit equilibrium and tractable stochastic dynamics. A finite volume $V$ sets a crossover length $l_c \sim \ln V$ that splits the equilibrium into two sectors. Below $l_c$ each assembly occurs in many copies and the rank-frequency distribution is Zipf-like; above $l_c$ individual species are rare and fluctuation-dominated. The statistical weight of the rare sector decays slowly with volume, controlling the finite-size scaling of diversity, Shannon entropy, and other assembly-weighted observables. The equilibrium also admits a transparent grand-canonical description in terms of a bond energy and an atomic chemical potential. Together these results make the model a controlled neutral baseline against which selection and driving in richer assembly networks can be measured.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个由可逆凝聚和碎裂反应构成的平均场反应网络，其中物种是由相同原子组装成的有序二叉树。模型存在显式平衡态和可处理的随机动力学。有限体积V导致一个特征长度l_c∼lnV，将平衡态分为两个扇区：低于l_c时每个组装体有多份拷贝，等级-频率分布呈Zipf律；高于l_c时单个物种稀有且受涨落主导。稀有扇区的统计权重随体积缓慢衰减，控制着多样性、香农熵等可观测量。该模型可作为更丰富组装网络中选择和驱动的受控中性基线。
AI.motivation: 作者希望构建一个具有精确可解性的组装网络模型，作为衡量更复杂网络中选择和驱动效应的中性基线。
AI.method: 研究平均场反应网络，物种为由相同原子通过可逆凝聚和碎裂反应组装成的有序二叉树。利用Catalan数描述物种数量的组合增长，通过有限体积V引入特征长度l_c，区分常见物种和稀有物种两个扇区，并建立巨正则系综描述。
AI.result: 发现有限体积V产生交叉长度l_c∼lnV，两个扇区行为不同：短链物种呈Zipf分布，长链物种稀有且受涨落主导。稀有扇区的统计权重随体积缓慢衰减，决定了多样性等可观测量的有限尺寸标度。
AI.conclusion: 该模型提供了一个可控的中性基线，可用于衡量更丰富组装网络中选择和驱动的效应。

title: Perturbations in the spin-orbital liquid (the Yao-Lee model)
summary: I investigate the stability of the spin-orbital liquid described by the Yao-Lee model in the presence of multiple perturbations that naturally arise in a recently proposed microscopic realization. While most perturbations are irrelevant and do not qualitatively alter the exact solvability, we find that the Kitaev interaction plays a special role: it couples to the $ \mathbb{Z}_2 $ gauge field and renders the visons mobile.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了Yao-Lee模型描述的自旋-轨道液体的稳定性，发现Kitaev相互作用可使visons移动，从而改变系统行为。
AI.motivation: 探究Yao-Lee模型中自旋-轨道液体在多种微扰下的稳定性，尤其是微观实现中自然出现的扰动对其精确可解性的影响。
AI.method: 通过在Yao-Lee模型中引入多种自然出现的扰动，分析各扰动对系统稳定性的影响，特别关注Kitaev相互作用的角色。
AI.result: 大多数扰动是无关的，不改变系统的精确可解性；但Kitaev相互作用会耦合到Z₂规范场，使visons变得可移动。
AI.conclusion: Kitaev相互作用在破坏Yao-Lee模型精确可解性方面起关键作用，使原本静态的visons获得动力学特性。

title: Monte-Carlo solution of the Kondo model
summary: The Kondo model is a paradigmatic quantum impurity problem realized in a wide variety of experimental platforms and central to the study of strongly correlated electrons. We introduce a discrete model that exactly reproduces the multichannel Kondo model and demonstrate that it can be simulated efficiently. Using cluster Monte Carlo algorithms, we completely eliminate critical slowing down, providing direct access to universal crossover functions and transport properties across a broad range of parameters. Remarkably, the same model captures both the weak- and strong-coupling regimes, unifying descriptions traditionally derived in complementary limits and revealing their common origin. Our method naturally accommodates large channel numbers, anisotropy, interacting one-dimensional leads, and channel asymmetry, yielding predictions for transport properties in charge-Kondo devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种离散模型，能精确再现多通道Kondo模型，并通过聚类蒙特卡洛算法消除临界慢化，统一了弱耦合与强耦合描述，可高效模拟量子杂质问题。
AI.motivation: Kondo模型是强关联电子系统的核心问题，但传统数值方法存在临界慢化，且弱耦合与强耦合区域通常需要分开处理，缺乏统一的模拟框架。
AI.method: 引入一个离散模型精确对应多通道Kondo模型，采用聚类蒙特卡洛算法进行模拟，消除临界慢化，支持大通道数、各向异性、一维相互作用引线及通道不对称性。
AI.result: 成功统一了弱耦合与强耦合区域，揭示了二者的共同起源；能直接计算通用交叉函数和输运性质，适用于多种复杂场景（如电荷Kondo器件）。
AI.conclusion: 该离散模型+聚类蒙特卡洛方法为Kondo模型提供了一种高效、统一的模拟方案，可拓展至更多实验相关参数下的量子杂质问题研究。

title: Bright and Dark Excitons in CrSBr: Local Ligand-Field Character and Band-Coherent Optical Selection Rules
summary: Magnetic van der Waals semiconductors such as CrSBr host an intricate exciton landscape whose physical interpretation has converged only recently. A many-body Feynman diagrammatic approach based on quasiparticle self-consistent GW with electron-hole ladder vertex corrections to the screened Coulomb interaction has established the electronic band gap, excitonic orbital character, real-space extent, binding energies, and bosonic-coupling signatures of the bright XA exciton near 1.34 eV and the higher XB manifold near 1.8 eV. These results agree well with ARPES and magneto-optical experiments and supersede the early Rydberg-like assignment of the excitons. What has remained unresolved is why these intense bright excitons coexist, within a few tens of meV, with companion states that are several orders of magnitude darker despite drawing from essentially the same single-particle transition manifold. Here we show that brightness is a band-coherent property of the excitonic eigenfunctions: bright and dark partners are sublattice-symmetric and sublattice-antisymmetric superpositions of the same ligand-field-like Bloch transitions across the two Cr atoms of the orthorhombic primitive cell. The commonly used Frenkel and Wannier-Mott labels describe what an exciton is made of, but brightness requires a symmetry-adapted interference rule between transition dipoles. Disentangling this bare excitonic structure is a prerequisite for interpreting the optical response of CrSBr once magnon, phonon, and photon couplings are included.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了CrSBr中明亮激子与暗伴生态共存的机制：亮度是激子本征函数的能带相干性，源于两个Cr原子上布洛赫跃迁的亚晶格对称/反对称叠加，而非传统Frenkel或Wannier-Mott分类所能解释。
AI.motivation: 尽管CrSBr中XA激子(1.34 eV)和XB激子(1.8 eV)的能隙、轨道特征、空间范围等已被GW+电子-空穴梯级修正方法成功解释，但明亮激子为何能在几十meV内与暗态伴生共存（尽管源自相同的单粒子跃迁流形）这一问题尚未解决。
AI.method: 从多体Feynman图论方法出发（基于准粒子自洽GW和电子-空穴梯级顶点修正），通过分析激子本征函数的能带相干性，发现亮度源于亚晶格对称（明亮）与亚晶格反对称（暗）的叠加态，这是一种跃迁偶极子间的对称性适配干涉规则。
AI.result: 明亮激子与其暗伴生态本质上是相同配位场类Bloch跃迁在正交晶系初基胞两个Cr原子上的亚晶格对称和亚晶格反对称叠加。传统Frenkel和Wannier-Mott标签只能描述激子的组成，无法解释亮度差异。
AI.conclusion: 澄清这一裸激子结构是理解CrSBr在耦合磁子、声子和光子后光学响应的前提。

title: Signature in sound-mode of the exciton bilayer two-dimensional superfluid transition
summary: Obtaining definitive evidence of exciton superfluidity in electron-hole bilayers in zero magnetic field remains a major longstanding challenge since the condensate is electrically neutral, making its phase coherence difficult to detect directly. We show that the Anderson-Bogoliubov sound velocity provides a dynamical signature of exciton superfluidity. Across the BCS-BEC crossover, the velocity is known to discontinuously drop to zero at the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) transition. The magnitude of the drop has a strong density dependence. We compute this behavior, with the inclusion of finite-temperature screening, and determine the BKT transition using a renormalization-group approach. We further identify a temperature window which is experimentally accessible, where vortex-antivortex excitations strongly renormalize both the sound velocity and the transition temperature.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了安德森-博戈留波夫声速可作为电子-空穴双层体系中激子超流的动力学特征，研究了BCS-BEC渡越中声速在BKT转变处的跳变行为，并确定了实验可访问的温度窗口。
AI.motivation: 零磁场下电子-空穴双层中激子超流体的相干性难以直接探测，亟需一种可靠的动力学特征来证实其存在。
AI.method: 结合有限温度屏蔽效应，利用重整化群方法确定BKT转变，分析声速在BCS-BEC渡越中的行为。
AI.result: 发现声速在BKT转变处存在不连续跳变，跳变幅度具有强密度依赖性；涡旋-反涡旋激发显著重整了声速和转变温度。
AI.conclusion: 安德森-博戈留波夫声速可作为激子超流体的可观测动力学信号，且存在实验可行的温度窗口用于观测该效应。

title: Generation and Characterization of Surface-Attached Ultrathin Liquid Sheets for Grazing-Incidence X-ray Scattering
summary: Capturing the ultrafast structural dynamics that occur at the solid-liquid interface is key to understanding adsorption, desorption, diffusion, and aggregation processes in catalysis and interfacial chemical reactions. Hard-X-ray scattering in grazing-incidence geometry can, in principle, access interfacial structural changes with angstrom-scale structural sensitivity and ultrafast temporal resolution. However, the long optical paths of the optical pump and hard-X-ray pulses inside the liquid sample pose significant challenges to the temporal resolution, signal-to-noise ratio, and overall stability of such an experimental scheme. Here, we report a method for creating and characterizing ultrathin surface-attached free-flowing liquid sheets, whose submicrometer thickness enables ultrafast temporal resolution and reduces the bulk-liquid scattering contribution. The impinging-jet geometry produces stable micrometer-scale sheets whose morphology depends systematically on incidence angle, jet velocity, and capillary diameter. Gas-assisted shaping using a second capillary further narrows and thins the sheet, producing an extended ultrathin region and reducing the measured minimum thickness below 500~nm for acetonitrile. The resulting platform provides a reproducible, continuously flowing, surface-attached liquid geometry for grazing-incidence scattering experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种创建超薄表面附着自由流动液片的方法，其亚微米厚度可实现超快时间分辨并减少体相液体散射，为掠入射散射实验提供可重复、连续流动的液体几何构型。
AI.motivation: 在固液界面捕捉超快结构动力学对理解催化及界面化学反应中的吸附、脱附、扩散和聚集过程至关重要。掠入射硬X射线散射虽理论上可达到埃级结构灵敏度和超快时间分辨率，但光泵和硬X射线脉冲在液体样品中的长光路严重制约了时间分辨率、信噪比和整体稳定性。
AI.method: 提出一种创造和表征超薄表面附着自由流动液片的方法。利用喷射射流几何产生稳定微米级液片，其形态随入射角、射流速度和毛细管直径系统变化；进一步通过第二毛细管进行气体辅助成形，使液片变窄变薄，形成扩展的超薄区域，将乙腈的最小测量厚度降至500 nm以下。
AI.result: 成功产生了亚微米厚度的表面附着自由流动液片，最小厚度低于500 nm（乙腈），有效减少了体相液体散射贡献，实现了可重复、连续流动的液体几何构型。
AI.conclusion: 该平台为掠入射散射实验提供了一种稳定、可重复、连续流动的表面附着液体几何方案，有望推动固液界面超快结构动力学研究。

title: Interfacial chirality-induced magnetic-field-free switching with high energy efficiency in all-vdW heterostructures
comment: Accepted by Nature Communications; 30 pages; 4 main figures; 12 supporting figures
summary: Chirality, a central concept across many scientific disciplines, continues to inspire the discovery of novel physical phenomena. In condensed matter physics, structural chirality - defined by the absence of mirror plane symmetries - has primarily been explored in bulk materials. However, new chiral phenomena can emerge uniquely at the interface, distinct from their bulk counterparts, when a chiral material forms a heterostructure. Here, we demonstrate that all van-der-Waals (vdW) heterostructure composed of the chiral Co1/3TaS2 and the achiral vdW ferromagnet Fe3GeTe2 exhibits two distinct and unconventional spin-orbit torques originating from the interfacial chirality. These torques enable magnetic-field-free switching of perpendicular magnetization with ultralow current density ~ 10^6 A/cm^2 and minimal power dissipation < 10^15 W/m^3. Moreover, by replacing Fe3GeTe2 with a similar vdW ferromagnet, Fe3GaTe2, but of higher Curie temperature, we achieved the magnetic-field-free switching at room temperature in the Fe3GaTe2/Co1/3TaS2 vdW heterostructure. Our findings establish interfacial chirality as a powerful new handle for spintronic control, opening a new pathway to explore chirality-induced phenomena beyond the bulk symmetry constraints - and paving the way toward highly efficient, low-power spintronic devices based on all-vdW heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了手性材料Co1/3TaS2与非手性铁磁体Fe3GeTe2组成的全范德华异质结中，界面手性产生了两种非常规自旋轨道扭矩，实现了无磁场、超低电流密度（~10^6 A/cm²）的垂直磁化翻转，并通过替换更高居里温度的材料在室温下实现了该效应，为超低功耗自旋电子学器件开辟了新路径。
AI.motivation: 探索界面手性（而非传统体手性）在范德华异质结中产生的新颖物理现象，特别是自旋轨道扭矩效应，以实现低功耗、无磁场的磁化翻转。
AI.method: 构建了全范德华异质结：手性Co1/3TaS2与非手性铁磁体Fe3GeTe2（或Fe3GaTe2）堆叠，通过界面手性产生非常规自旋轨道扭矩，驱动垂直磁化翻转。
AI.result: 成功实现了无磁场辅助的垂直磁化翻转，电流密度低至~10^6 A/cm²，功耗小于10^15 W/m³；并在室温下（Fe3GaTe2/Co1/3TaS2体系）实现了该效应。
AI.conclusion: 界面手性是一种调控自旋电子学的新手段，突破了传统体对称性限制，为基于全范德华异质结的高效、低功耗自旋电子器件提供了新方向。

title: Universality of Measurement-Induced Criticality under Symmetry-Breaking Measurements
summary: We study the critical properties of random quantum circuits with a $U(1)$ symmetry subject to local projective measurements that explicitly break this symmetry. We find that, at the measurement-induced phase transition, symmetry-breaking measurements act as a relevant perturbation at large scales, leading to the same universal critical properties as the corresponding monitored random circuit with non-symmetric unitary dynamics. In particular, we consider monitored $U(1)$-symmetric Haar-random circuits in the limit of large local Hilbert-space dimension, where the trajectory-averaged entanglement entropy can be exactly obtained in terms of a classical statistical mechanics model. In this model, the charge associated with the conservation law follows a symmetric simple exclusion process, in which symmetry-breaking measurements correspond to disordered defects that create and destroy charges. We prove that the charge correlation length remains finite for any measurement rate, ruling out a charge-sharpening transition, in contrast to the case of symmetry-preserving measurements. We further support our predictions at finite local Hilbert-space dimension through numerical finite-size scaling analyses of the entanglement transition in monitored $U(1)$-symmetric Haar and stabilizer random circuits.

AI.tldr: 研究了具有U(1)对称性的随机量子电路在对称性破缺投影测量下的临界性质，发现对称性破缺测量在测量诱导相变中作为相关扰动，导致与无对称性随机电路相同的普适临界性质。
AI.motivation: 探究对称性破缺测量如何影响具有U(1)对称性的随机量子电路的测量诱导相变行为。
AI.method: 采用大局域希尔伯特空间维度的极限，利用经典统计力学模型精确得到轨迹平均纠缠熵；结合数值有限尺寸标度分析，研究Haar随机电路和稳定子电路中的纠缠相变。
AI.result: 对称性破缺测量使电荷关联长度在任何测量率下均有限，排除了电荷锐化相变；对称性破缺测量作为相关扰动，导致与无对称性随机电路相同的普适临界性质。
AI.conclusion: 对称性破缺测量在测量诱导相变中改变了临界行为，使电荷守恒不再产生电荷锐化相变，而纠缠相变的普适类与无对称性情况一致。

title: Tunable Emergent Gauge Fields from Skyrmions in a Quasicrystalline Lattice
summary: We study magnetic skyrmions in a two-dimensional quasicrystalline lattice using a classical Heisenberg model with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions and an external magnetic field. The competition between the skyrmion-skyrmion repulsion and an emergent quasiperiodic pinning landscape gives rise to a sequence of distinct skyrmion lattice configurations as a function of field. The resulting hierarchy of quasiperiodic pinning potentials, characterized by closely spaced quasi-degenerate minima, enables a quasi-continuous suppression of the skyrmion density as the saturation field is approached, in sharp contrast to the strongly first-order collapse of skyrmion crystals on periodic lattices. This provides a direct mechanism for controlling the topological charge and, consequently, the emergent gauge field for itinerant electrons. As a consequence, the Hall conductivity can be strongly modified with small changes in the magnetic field and driven smoothly to zero near saturation. This field-controlled tunability, rooted in the underlying multistability, identifies quasicrystalline magnets as a platform for tunable topological textures, with potential applications in magnetic memory and magnetoelectronic response.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了二维准晶格上的磁性斯格明子，发现准周期性钉扎势与斯格明子间排斥作用的竞争导致了一系列独特的晶格构型。这种准周期性使得斯格明子密度随磁场增加近乎连续地降低（而非周期性晶格中的一阶塌缩），从而实现了对拓扑荷和霍尔电导率的平滑调控，为可调拓扑磁结构提供了新平台。
AI.motivation: 探索准晶格中斯格明子的行为，尤其是其与周期性晶格中的显著差异，并利用准晶的多重亚稳态实现对外场响应（如拓扑荷、霍尔电导率）的精细调控。
AI.method: 基于经典海森堡模型，引入Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用和外磁场，在二维准晶格上进行数值模拟，研究斯格明子晶格构型随磁场的变化。
AI.result: 准周期钉扎势中紧密排列的准简并极小值使得斯格明子密度随磁场可近乎连续地抑制到零，而非周期性晶格中的强一阶塌缩。霍尔电导率可通过小幅改变磁场被显著且平滑地调节至零。
AI.conclusion: 准晶磁体作为可调拓扑纹理的平台，其场控可调性源于多稳态特性，在磁存储和磁电子响应方面具有潜在应用价值。

title: Gate induced strain on a two-dimensional hole gas in silicon
summary: We show the effect of gate-induced strain on the valence band of a silicon (Si) metal oxide semiconductor (MOS) confined two-dimensional hole gas (2DHG). Increasing aluminum gate thickness, and thereby the strain in the channel, results in the onset of a second subband contributing to Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations. Temperature-dependent magnetotransport measurements reveal distinct cyclotron masses of $m_c^*=(0.36\pm0.04)m_0$ and $m_c^*=(0.49\pm0.02)m_0$. The measured cyclotron masses differ from those expected for an idealized heavy-hole (HH)/light-hole (LH) picture, reflecting the combined influence of quantum confinement, strain, and HH-LH mixing on the valence band.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了铝栅极厚度引起的应变对硅MOS二维空穴气价带的影响，发现应变导致第二子带出现，并测量到两种不同的回旋质量，与理想重空穴/轻空穴模型不符。
AI.motivation: 探究栅极诱导应变对硅MOS结构中二维空穴气价带结构的影响，理解应变如何调控空穴子带和有效质量。
AI.method: 通过改变铝栅极厚度引入应变，利用Shubnikov-de Haas振荡和变温磁输运测量表征空穴子带结构和回旋质量。
AI.result: 增加铝栅厚度导致第二子带参与SdH振荡；测量到两种回旋质量分别为0.36m₀和0.49m₀，与理想重空穴/轻空穴模型预测值有偏差。
AI.conclusion: 量子限域、应变和轻重空穴混合效应共同决定了硅二维空穴气的价带结构，不能简单用理想HH/LH图像描述。

title: Theoretical exploration of Be Ag(II) F phases and their magnetic properties using learning algorithms
comment: 8 pages, 4 Figures, 2 Tables, and electronic supplement of 18 pages
summary: The search for novel silver(II) fluorides is driven by their potential as electronic and magnetic analogues to high temperature cuprate(II) superconductor precursors. Here, we explore the previously uncharted Be Ag(II) F chemical space using global structure prediction algorithms combined with first principles calculations. Focusing on the AgBeF4 stoichiometry, we identify the five lowest enthalpy polymorphs crystallizing in the C2, P minus 1, and P 21/c space groups. All polymorphs show an antiferromagnetic ground state, with AgBeF4_4 and AgBeF4_5 exhibiting unprecedented strong superexchange interactions of J equal circa to minus 460meV and J equal circa to minus 359meV respectively. Those high J values are due to the presence of either [Ag2F7] for AgBeF4_4, or related infinite [AgF2/2+2/1]2 minus chains for AgBeF4_5. Although the phases are found to be metastable with respect to binary difluorides, the thermodynamic analysis suggests that they could be targeted via synthetic routes employing fluorine radicals, with reaction enthalpies reaching minus 370 kJ/mol.

AI.tldr: 本文通过全局结构预测和第一性原理计算，发现了AgBeF4的五种低焓多晶型物，它们具有反铁磁基态，其中两种表现出前所未有的大超交换相互作用（J约-460 meV和-359 meV），并分析了其热力学稳定性及合成可行性。
AI.motivation: 探索新型银(II)氟化物作为高温铜(II)氧化物超导体前驱体的电子和磁性类似物，填补Be-Ag(II)-F化学空间的空白。
AI.method: 采用全局结构预测算法结合第一性原理计算，聚焦AgBeF4化学计量比，识别五种最低焓多晶型物（空间群C2、P-1、P21/c），并计算其超交换相互作用、热力学稳定性及反应焓。
AI.result: 五种多晶型物均为反铁磁基态。AgBeF4_4和AgBeF4_5表现出前所未有的强超交换相互作用（J≈-460 meV和J≈-359 meV），归因于[Ag2F7]单元或无限[AgF2/2+2/1]²⁻链的存在。所有相相对于二元氟化物亚稳态，但通过氟自由基合成路线反应焓可达-370 kJ/mol。
AI.conclusion: AgBeF4多晶型物虽为亚稳态，但强超交换相互作用和热力学可行合成路线使其成为有前景的铜酸盐类似物候选材料。

title: Charge-partition pathways in strong-field photoionization of carbonyl sulfide monomers and dimers
summary: Strong-field photoionization of molecules and molecular clusters gives rise to a rich variety of fragmentation pathways governed by charge localization and redistribution on ultrafast timescales. Here, we report a velocity-map imaging study of the strong-field photoionization and fragmentation of carbonyl sulfide (OCS) monomers and dimers driven by 150 femtosecond (fs) laser pulses at 775~nm. The images of the total kinetic-energy and angular distributions of the OCS$^{2+}$, S$^+$, and CO$^+$ fragments were interpreted with the help of electronic-structure calculations of the potential energy surfaces for OCS$^+$ and OCS$^{2+}$. We identify distinct dissociation pathways of singly and doubly ionized OCS, including two-body breakup channels of OCS$^+$ into $\mathrm{S}^+ + \mathrm{CO}$ and $\mathrm{CO}^+ + \mathrm{S}$, dissociation of OCS$^{2+}$ into $\mathrm{S}^+ + \mathrm{CO}$$^+$ as well as higher-order three-body fragmentation. In addition, the images of the OCS$^{2+}$ channel exhibit near-zero-momentum components, low-energy isotropic features, and highly anisotropic contributions at high kinetic energies that cannot be explained by monomer ionization alone. Analysis of the KER distributions and angular anisotropies indicates that these features originate from the breakup of multiply charged OCS dimers ((OCS)$_2^{2+}$, (OCS)$_2^{3+}$, and (OCS)$_2^{4+}$) through charge-separation channels. Our results illustrate how dynamic signatures of strong-field fragmentation evolve from intramolecular dissociation in isolated molecules to intermolecular charge separation in weakly bound clusters providing a unified picture of charge-driven dissociation dynamics beyond the single-molecule limit.

AI.tldr: 本文通过速度成像和电子结构计算，研究了OCS单体和二聚体在强激光场下的光电离和碎裂动力学，识别了从分子内解离到分子间电荷分离的多种碎裂路径，揭示了超越单分子极限的电荷驱动解离统一图像。
AI.motivation: 探索强场光电离中分子与分子团簇的碎裂路径如何受电荷定位与超快再分布调控，以及从单分子解离到弱束缚团簇中分子间电荷分离的动力学演化。
AI.method: 速度成像技术结合150飞秒、775nm激光脉冲，辅以电子结构计算解析OCS$^+$和OCS$^{2+}$的势能面，分析碎片动能与角分布。
AI.result: 识别了OCS$^+$和OCS$^{2+}$的多条二体和三体解离通道；发现OCS$^{2+}$图像中近零动量、低能各向同性和高能高度各向异性的特征，归因于(OCS)$_2^{2+}$、(OCS)$_2^{3+}$和(OCS)$_2^{4+}$的电荷分离碎裂。
AI.conclusion: 强场碎裂动力学从孤立分子的分子内解离到弱束缚团簇的分子间电荷分离存在演化关系，提供了超越单分子极限的电荷驱动解离统一图像。

title: Helically Enhanced Chiroptical Response and Symmetry Breaking in Conjugated Polymers
summary: Chiral $π$-conjugated polymers are an attractive material platform for spin polarized carrier-transport and spectroscopy, but fundamental considerations for how torsional disorder influences the response properties of the material have not been considered. Here we combine atomistic electronic structure modeling with with experimental spectroscopic measurements to examine symmetry breaking in the prototypical $π$-conjugated polymer polyacetylene, (CH)$_x$. Chiral (CH)$_x$ oligomers are generated in distinct conformations which differ in their out-of-plane tonsorial ordering. We find that a \textit{helical }conformation introduces orders of magnitude enhanced chiroptical activity due to a solenoid effect. This effect is visualized by the Transition Chiral Tensor analysis which shows signatures of domain ordering which eliminates destructive interference between electric and magnetic contributions. These findings highlight the capability to develop a hierarchical interpretation relating local, fragment symmetry breaking to global, nonlocal interactions governing chiroptical response in emerging chiral materials.

AI.tldr: 本文结合原子级电子结构建模与实验光谱测量，研究了手性π共轭聚合物聚乙炔中扭转无序对光学响应性质的影响，发现螺旋构象通过螺线管效应显著增强手性光学活性，并揭示了从局域对称性破缺到全局非局域相互作用的分层解释框架。
AI.motivation: 手性π共轭聚合物在自旋极化载流子输运和光谱学中具有重要应用前景，但扭转无序如何影响材料的响应性质这一基本问题尚未被研究。
AI.method: 采用原子级电子结构建模与实验光谱测量相结合的方法，生成不同构象的手性聚乙炔低聚物，并通过Transition Chiral Tensor分析可视化手性光学活性。
AI.result: 螺旋构象由于螺线管效应，手性光学活性增强数个数量级；Transition Chiral Tensor分析显示域有序性消除了电偶极与磁偶极贡献之间的相消干涉。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了从局域片段对称性破缺到全局非局域相互作用的分层解释框架，为理解新兴手性材料的手性光学响应提供了新视角。

title: Scalable Simulation of Strongly Correlated Electron-Phonon Systems via Non-Gaussian Matrix Product States
summary: We investigate strongly correlated electron-phonon (e-ph) systems via a non-Gaussian matrix product state method. By combining non-Gaussian states with matrix product states, our method efficiently characterizes the intractable entanglement between strongly correlated electrons and phononic modes of unbounded Hilbert space, enabling scalable simulations across broad parameter regimes. In one-dimensional generalized Hubbard--Holstein (HH) models, we identify a pronounced tendency toward phase separation (PS), an instability relevant to recent angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy observations on doped cuprate chain. In two-dimensional HH models, we construct the phase diagram at half-filling featuring a metallic phase emerging from the competition between non-local phonon-mediated attraction and local Hubbard repulsion. Upon doping, we elucidate the role of soft phonons in stabilizing stripe phases. In the antiferromagnet, the stabilization of the fully filled stripe is attributed to a local retardation effect, wherein the charge order is pinned by phonons, leading to a diminished response to spin fluctuations. In the doped charge-density-wave regime, a novel bipolaronic stripe phase with an enlarged unit cell is stabilized via a non-local retardation effect, where long-range phonon-mediated interactions suppress PS. Our work establishes a systematic route to decoding the e-ph interplay that is crucial for superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用非高斯矩阵乘积态方法研究强关联电子-声子体系，在一维和二维广义Hubbard-Holstein模型中揭示了相分离、金属相、条纹相等丰富相图，阐明了声子延迟效应对电荷序和自旋涨落的调控机制。
AI.motivation: 强关联电子-声子体系中电子与无穷维希尔伯特空间的声子模式之间存在难以处理的纠缠，传统方法难以在大参数范围内进行可扩展模拟，亟需有效计算方法来揭示电子-声子相互作用在高温超导等关键物理现象中的角色。
AI.method: 提出非高斯矩阵乘积态方法，结合非高斯态与矩阵乘积态的优势，高效刻画强关联电子与无界希尔伯特空间声子模式之间的纠缠，实现对广义Hubbard-Holstein模型在宽参数范围内的可扩展模拟。
AI.result: 在一维模型中发现了与掺杂铜酸盐链的ARPES观测相关的相分离倾向；在二维半填充模型中构建了非局域声子介导吸引与局域Hubbard排斥竞争的金属相图；在掺杂体系中揭示了软声子稳定条纹相的作用；在反铁磁中局域延迟效应使电荷序被声子钉扎、减小了对自旋涨落的响应；在掺杂电荷密度波区中非局域延迟效应稳定了具有放大晶胞的新型双极化子条纹相并抑制了相分离。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一条系统解码电子-声子相互作用的路径，这种相互作用对理解超导至关重要。

title: Interplay of Quasiperiodic Criticality and the Non-Hermitian Skin Effect
summary: Quasiperiodic lattices can host critical eigenstates, whereas nonreciprocal hopping in non-Hermitian lattices can induce non-Hermitian skin effect. In this work, we investigate localization phenomena in a Hatano--Nelson model with quasiperiodically modulated hopping amplitudes, where nonreciprocity arises from unequal modulation strengths of the right and left hoppings. Using a non-unitary gauge transformation, we map the non-Hermitian system into a Hermitian quasiperiodic system and obtain an exact analytical expression for the Lyapunov exponent in the thermodynamic limit. Under periodic boundary conditions, inverse participation ratios and finite-size scaling analysis are used to identify the quasiperiodic critical regimes. The comparison shows that parameter regimes hosting quasiperiodic critical states under periodic boundary conditions can exhibit the non-Hermitian skin effect under open boundary conditions. Furthermore, the non-Hermitian skin effect associated with quasiperiodic critical regimes is also observed in representative long-range hopping models and multiband extensions. Our results provide an analytically controlled perspective on how quasiperiodicity, modulated nonreciprocity, and boundary conditions jointly shape the non-Hermitian skin effect in critical regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究准周期调制的Hatano-Nelson模型中非互易跳跃导致的局域化现象，发现准周期临界态在开放边界条件下会表现出非厄米趋肤效应，并通过非幺正规范变换精确求解了Lyapunov指数。
AI.motivation: 探究准周期晶格中的临界本征态与非互易跳跃导致的非厄米趋肤效应之间的相互作用机制，理解准周期调制、非互易性和边界条件如何共同影响非厄米趋肤效应。
AI.method: 采用非幺正规范变换将非厄米系统映射为厄米准周期系统，在热力学极限下解析求解Lyapunov指数；通过周期边界下的逆参与率和有限尺寸标度分析识别准周期临界区域。
AI.result: 周期边界下处于准周期临界态的参数区域在开放边界下会表现出非厄米趋肤效应；这种效应在长程跳跃模型和多能带扩展中同样存在。
AI.conclusion: 为准周期、调制非互易性和边界条件如何共同塑造临界区域中的非厄米趋肤效应提供了精确可控的理论视角。

title: Influence of electronic correlations on disorder-induced loop currents in high-Tc superconductors
summary: Time-reversal symmetry breaking in superconducting systems can manifest itself in the form of currents which are induced by inhomogeneities in the charge and order parameter distribution. With regard to cuprates such states have been theoretically studied in the overdoped region of the phase diagram where the inhomogeneities are related to out-of plane dopants. In this paper we will extend previous work by including local correlations within the unrestricted Gutzwiller approximation in order to study its impact on the induced loop currents. In addition, we investigate the effect of next-nearest neighbor hopping which extends the TRSB phase towards half-filling. We find that in general correlations lead to a suppression of loop currents, however, the Gutzwiller approach can sustain such states to larger values of the local on-site repulsion as compared to the Hartree-Fock approximation. Our investigations allow for an estimation of the local magnetic moment emerging from impurity-induced loop currents for cuprate superconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究铜氧化物超导体中时间反演对称性破缺(TRSB)导致的环流，通过无限制Gutzwiller近似研究局域关联对环流的影响，发现关联抑制环流但比Hartree-Fock近似更能维持这种状态，并考察了次近邻跳跃对TRSB相的影响。
AI.motivation: 前人已研究过掺杂诱导的TRSB环流态，但未充分考虑局域关联效应。本文旨在通过无限制Gutzwiller近似引入局域关联，研究其对环流的影响，并考察次近邻跳跃的作用。
AI.method: 采用无限制Gutzwiller近似引入局域关联，结合次近邻跳跃项，研究铜氧化物超导体中杂质诱导的环流态，并与Hartree-Fock近似结果进行对比。
AI.result: 1) 局域关联总体上抑制环流；2) Gutzwiller近似比Hartree-Fock近似能在更大的局域在位排斥强度下维持TRSB环流态；3) 次近邻跳跃可将TRSB相向半填充扩展。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了对铜氧化物超导体中杂质诱导环流产生的局域磁矩的估计，揭示了关联效应对TRSB环流态的影响机制。

title: State-Averaged Density Matrix Embedding Theory for Local Excitations
summary: Density matrix embedding theory (DMET) provides an elegant framework in quantum chemistry to describe local properties of chemical systems that allows a high-level method being used to solve an embedded subsystem constructed based on a low-level treatment of the whole system, and therefore achieves a balance between efficiency and accuracy. However, because the embedded subspace in DMET is typically constructed from the mean-field ground state Slater determinant, the resulting bath orbitals inherently favor the ground state, leading to unbalanced descriptions of ground and excited states for local excitations. In this work, we first demonstrate the starting-point dependence of DMET in excitation energy calculations, and then generalize original ground-state based DMET by extending the starting point from the single Slater determinant to state-averaged (SA) complete active space self-consistent field (CASSCF), hence termed as SA-DMDT. In calculations of magnetic anisotropy and excitation energies of transition metal and lanthanide complexes, SA-DMET shows significant improvement in accuracy compared to the single-state DMET. Configuration-averaged Hartree-Fock (CAHF), which is equivalent to SA-CASSCF when all states in the chosen active space are equally averaged, is found to give comparable accuracy as a DMET starting point, thus offering a more efficient choice for state-averaged embedding. Finally, the recently proposed non-orthongal atomic-orbital-based DMET (AO-DMET) is tested on various systems and gives very promising results in all cases. These results establish SA-DMET, especially in combination with AO-DMET and CAHF, as a robust and efficient embedding framework for local excited states in strongly correlated metal complexes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出状态平均密度矩阵嵌入理论（SA-DMET），通过将起始点从单Slater行列式扩展至态平均CASSCF，解决了传统DMET在激发态计算中描述不平衡的问题，在过渡金属和镧系配合物的磁各向异性和激发能计算中表现出显著精度提升。
AI.motivation: 传统DMET基于基态Slater行列式构建嵌入子空间，导致其自然偏向基态，对局域激发的基态和激发态描述不平衡，影响激发能计算精度。
AI.method: 将DMET的起始点从单Slater行列式扩展为态平均（SA）CASSCF，形成SA-DMET；同时引入组态平均Hartree-Fock（CAHF）作为更高效的替代方案，并测试非正交原子轨道基DMET（AO-DMET）。
AI.result: 在过渡金属和镧系配合物的磁各向异性和激发能计算中，SA-DMET相比单态DMET精度显著提升；CAHF作为起始点可达到与SA-CASSCF相当的精度；AO-DMET在所有测试体系中均给出非常有希望的结果。
AI.conclusion: SA-DMET（尤其结合AO-DMET和CAHF）为强关联金属配合物中的局域激发态提供了一个鲁棒且高效的嵌入框架。

title: Perpendicular magnetic anisotropy tuning of macrospin-to-vortex transitions in Co-based artificial spin-vortex ice
summary: We investigate the macrospin-to-vortex (MS-to-V) transition in Co-based artificial spin-vortex ice (ASVI) in the presence of perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA) by spin-wave spectroscopy. Detailed micromagnetic simulations using mumax3 reveal that the PMA modifies the magnetic energy landscape and facilitates vortex formation, suggesting that PMA can enhance the transition probability. To seek experimental validation of this hypothesis, we prepared Ti (3 nm)/Co (10 nm)/Ti (3 nm)/Pt (2 nm) (TCT) and Ti (3 nm)/Co (10 nm)/Pt (2 nm) (TCP) multilayer stacks. Vibrating sample magnetometry measurements confirm that the TCP film exhibits a larger PMA than the TCT film. Using these stacks, we then investigate the MS-to-V transition probability in ASVIs and found that TCP ASVIs exhibit a higher transition probability than TCT ASVIs, in agreement with the simulation prediction. These findings identify PMA as an effective design parameter for controlling vortex formation in ASVIs and provide a promising route toward task-dependent tuning of fading-memory properties for physical reservoir computing based on artificial spin lattices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自旋波谱学研究了垂直磁各向异性（PMA）对Co基人工自旋涡冰（ASVI）中宏观自旋到涡旋（MS-to-V）转变的影响。微磁模拟表明PMA促进涡旋形成，实验上通过制备不同PMA强度的多层膜验证了这一预测，发现PMA越强，转变概率越高，为基于人工自旋晶格的物理储备池计算提供了调控手段。
AI.motivation: 探究垂直磁各向异性（PMA）能否作为有效设计参数来调控人工自旋涡冰（ASVI）中宏观自旋到涡旋的转变，进而为物理储备池计算中记忆特性的任务依赖调控提供新途径。
AI.method: 使用mumax3进行微磁模拟，分析PMA对磁能景观和涡旋形成的影响；制备Ti/Co/Ti/Pt（TCT）和Ti/Co/Pt（TCP）两种多层膜（后者具有更大PMA），通过振动样品磁强计表征PMA差异，再通过自旋波谱学实验测量ASVI中MS-to-V转变概率。
AI.result: 微磁模拟预测PMA可增强涡旋形成概率；实验证实TCP ASVI（PMA更大）比TCT ASVI表现出更高的MS-to-V转变概率，与模拟结果一致。
AI.conclusion: PMA是调控ASVI中涡旋形成的有效设计参数，为基于人工自旋晶格的物理储备池计算中任务依赖的衰减记忆特性调控提供了有前景的途径。

title: Emergent Topology from Nonlocal Electronic Correlations in One Dimension
comment: Main text:7 pages and 3 figures, Supplementary Material: 6 pages and 4 figures
summary: We demonstrate that electronic correlations in low-dimensional systems can induce topological phases starting from a topologically trivial noninteracting band structure. Using an advanced cluster-diagrammatic many-body approach applied to the one-dimensional extended Hubbard model, we show that tuning the nonlocal Coulomb interaction drives the emergence of bond-order-wave (BOW) and charge-density-wave (CDW) phases. Despite being interaction-driven and symmetry-broken, these states admit an effective low-energy single-particle description. In particular, the BOW phase maps onto an effective Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model, while the CDW phase, with subleading bond-order correlations, corresponds to a Rice-Mele model. Both phases exhibit a nontrivial topological character, manifested by the presence of localized edge states. Our results establish a mechanism by which nonlocal electronic correlations generate emergent topology in correlated systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究证明了在低维系统中，通过非局域电子关联可以从拓扑平庸的非相互作用能带结构中诱导出拓扑相。利用团簇图解多体方法研究一维扩展哈伯德模型，发现调节非局域库仑相互作用可驱动键序波（BOW）和电荷密度波（CDW）相的出现。这些相互作用驱动的对称破缺态可映射为有效的Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型（BOW相）或Rice-Mele模型（CDW相），并表现出非平庸拓扑性质，如局域边界态。
AI.motivation: 探索电子关联如何从拓扑平庸的能带结构中诱导出拓扑相，建立非局域相互作用与拓扑态之间的联系。
AI.method: 采用先进的团簇图解多体方法（cluster-diagrammatic many-body approach）研究一维扩展哈伯德模型（extended Hubbard model），通过调节非局域库仑相互作用参数来观察相变。
AI.result: 发现非局域库仑相互作用驱动了BOW相和CDW相的出现；BOW相可映射为SSH模型，CDW相可映射为Rice-Mele模型；两种相均表现出非平庸拓扑特征，存在局域边界态。
AI.conclusion: 非局域电子关联可以作为产生拓扑相的一种机制，为在关联体系中实现拓扑态提供了新途径。

title: Anomalous Reflection of Caustic Spin-Wave Beams in a Magnonic Waveguide
summary: Reflection of waves at interfaces is conventionally governed by Snell's law, which follows from conservation of momentum parallel to the interface. Here we show experimentally that caustic spin-wave beams in anisotropic media obey a fundamentally different reflection mechanism. Applying time-resolved Kerr microscopy to a yttrium iron garnet waveguide, we observe that reflected beams are selected by transitions between caustic points on the anisotropic iso-frequency contour rather than by momentum conservation. As a consequence, the reflected carrier wave vector and wavefront orientation exhibit trends opposite to those predicted by Snell's law. By tuning the magnitude and orientation of an external magnetic field, we continuously control the resulting reflection process and beam routing. Our results establish caustic-point transitions as a distinct reflection law for anisotropic wave beams and provide a route towards reconfigurable magnonic beam steering.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验证明，各向异性介质中的焦散自旋波束在界面反射时不遵循斯涅尔定律，而是由各向异性等频轮廓上的焦散点跃迁决定，实现了可重构的磁振子波束操控。
AI.motivation: 传统波的反射由斯涅尔定律（动量守恒）支配，但各向异性介质中是否存在不同的反射机制尚不清楚。本文旨在探究各向异性自旋波束在界面处的反射规律。
AI.method: 采用时间分辨克尔显微镜，对钇铁石榴石波导中的焦散自旋波束进行实验观测，分析其在不同外磁场强度和方向下的反射行为。
AI.result: 反射波束由各向异性等频轮廓上的焦散点跃迁选择，而非动量守恒；反射载波波矢和波前取向的变化趋势与斯涅尔定律预测相反；通过调节外磁场可连续控制反射过程。
AI.conclusion: 确立了焦散点跃迁作为各向异性波束的一种独特反射定律，为可重构磁振子波束控制提供了新途径。

title: Layer-resolved Electronic Structure and Correlation of Low-$n$ Square-planar Nickelates: A DFT+DMFT Prediction of Superconducting Candidates
summary: Multi-layer square-planar nickelates provide a rare platform in which the nominal Ni valence, dimensionality, and layer-resolved electronic structure can be tuned within the same structural family. Recent experiments have found superconductivity in $n=4$--8 $R_{n+1}Ni_nO_{2n+2}$ compounds, with the highest $T_c$ near $n=6$, whereas the more heavily hole-doped $n=3$ member remains nonsuperconducting. Here we propose spacer-layer Cl doping as a route to convert low-$n$ nickelates into superconducting candidates. Compared with changing the layer number $n$, Cl substitution on the spacer-layer oxygen sites offers a chemically natural way to continuously tune the Ni valence while leaving the NiO$_2$ planes largely intact; the lower-$n$ compounds may also be more accessible for synthesis. Using density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory, we show that electron-compensated $n=2$ and $n=3$ La-based nickelates, targeted to the nominal Ni valence of superconducting $n=6$, develop Ni-$d$ correlations comparable to those of superconducting higher-$n$ compounds while preserving the characteristic low-energy Ni-$d$ electronic structure. These results suggest spacer-layer Cl doping as a promising strategy for designing low-$n$ square-planar nickelate superconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过间隔层Cl掺杂将低n方形平面镍酸盐转化为超导体候选材料，理论计算表明该方法可使低n化合物获得与超导高n化合物相当的Ni-d电子关联和电子结构。
AI.motivation: 实验发现n=4-8的R_{n+1}Ni_nO_{2n+2}化合物具有超导性，Tc在n=6附近最高，而重空穴掺杂的n=3成员不超导。作者希望探索将低n镍酸盐转化为超导候选材料的途径。
AI.method: 提出间隔层Cl掺杂策略，利用密度泛函理论（DFT）结合动力学平均场理论（DMFT）进行电子结构计算，分析电子补偿后的n=2和n=3 La基镍酸盐的Ni-d电子关联和低能电子结构。
AI.result: 电子补偿后的n=2和n=3 La基镍酸盐（目标为超导n=6的名义Ni价态）发展出与超导高n化合物相当的Ni-d电子关联，同时保留了特征性的低能Ni-d电子结构。
AI.conclusion: 间隔层Cl掺杂是设计低n方形平面镍酸盐超导体的有前途的策略。

title: Phase stability and ionic transport in post-spinel CaV$_2$O$_4$ cathode
summary: Calcium-ion batteries (CBs) represent an alternative to lithium-ion technology but their advancement is limited by the lack of high-performance intercalation cathodes. Identified via computational screening, post-spinel CaV$_2$O$_4$ has emerged as a promising candidate, though its practical application is hindered by limited electrochemical capacity. Hence, we investigate the thermodynamic and ionic transport characteristics of Ca$_x$V$_2$O$_4$ ($0 \leq x \leq 1$) in this work, by integrating the cluster expansion formalism with Monte Carlo simulations and density functional theory based calculations. We construct the temperature-composition phase diagram of Ca$_x$V$_2$O$_4$ revealing several stable phases ($α$ through $ζ$) that can appear during electrochemical operations at different voltages. Importantly, we observe the formation of the $\varepsilon$ phase at $x \sim 0.83$ across a 370-590~K temperature window via invariant reactions, which agrees with observations in the experimental voltage profiles. Further, migration barrier calculations confirm that Ca mobility is severely impeded within the $α$ ($x \sim 0$) and $γ$ ($x \sim 0.5$) phases. With the strong Ca-vacancy ordering contributing to the high barrier in $γ$ and the persistent two-phase region stretching across the $δ$ ($x \sim 0.67$) and the $γ$ phases, we expect the accessible electrochemical capacity in the CaV$_2$O$_4$ system to be kinetically limited to at most half the theoretical capacity at 298~K, in agreement with experiments. Strategies including cation doping and particle size reduction can be considered to flatten the potential energy landscape of $γ$ and improve Ca mobility. Our computational findings highlight the interplay between stability and transport and provide design strategies that can enable the practical use of CaV$_2$O$_4$ as a CB cathode.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过计算筛选和热力学建模，揭示了CaV₂O₄作为钙离子电池正极材料的相变与离子输运特性，指出其电化学容量受限于动力学因素（最多理论容量的一半），并提出了掺杂和减小粒径等优化策略。
AI.motivation: 钙离子电池是锂离子电池的潜在替代方案，但缺乏高性能插层正极材料。计算筛选出的后尖晶石CaV₂O₄虽有前景，但实际电化学容量有限，需要深入理解其热力学和动力学限制机制。
AI.method: 结合团簇展开形式、蒙特卡洛模拟和密度泛函理论计算，构建Ca_xV₂O₄ (0≤x≤1)的温度-组分相图，并计算离子迁移能垒。
AI.result: 发现了多个稳定相（α到ζ），其中ε相（x~0.83）在370-590 K温度窗口形成，与实验电压曲线吻合；α和γ相中Ca迁移受阻严重；由于强的Ca-空位有序和两相区存在，298 K下可用容量最多为理论容量的一半。
AI.conclusion: CaV₂O₄作为钙离子电池正极的容量受动力学限制，可通过阳离子掺杂和减小颗粒尺寸来改善Ca迁移率，为其实用化提供了设计策略。

title: The charge density fluctuations and the Shrinking Fermi Liquid scenario for strange metallicity in cuprates
summary: We interpret the strange metal (SM) properties of slightly overdoped cuprates in terms of the recently proposed Shrinking Fermi Liquid theory. This is based on the pervading presence in the cuprate phase diagram of charge density fluctuations (CDF), which have been identified and characterized in RIXS. These fluctuations are abundant and have a low energy due to the proximity of the charge density wave quantum critical point hidden under the superconducting dome of cuprates, but have a short range and non-critical character with a finite energy M/γ~10 meV as measured above Tc. Here M~ ξ^-2 is determined by the short correlation length ξ, while γencodes the Landau damping ruling the lifetime of the charge fluctuations. Besides these low energy CDF, cuprates also display phonons and a broad continuum of particle-hole excitations, mostly due to spin paramagnons arising from their strongly correlated character. With these experimentally characterized ingredients we show that above Tc the SM properties in transport are well described in terms of fermionic Landau quasiparticles scattering with CDF and phonons. The optical properties can instead be interpreted by the combined effect of low energy CDF determining the temperature dependence, and of the paramagnon continuum determining a linear in frequency scattering rate. Remarkably, the combined effect of these simple ingredients also induces ω/T scaling properties for frequencies larger than M/γ. When superconductivity is suppressed by strong magnetic fields the SM properties extend down to a few Kelvin. By assuming that the CDF dissipation parameter γgrows logarithmically by lowering T, we account for all anomalous transport and thermodynamic properties of cuprates (specific heat, Seebeck, heat transport, resistivity, and magnetoresistance) thereby providing a consistent scenario for the SM phase of cuprates.

AI.tldr: 本文通过收缩费米液体理论，结合电荷密度涨落、声子和顺磁子等实验特征，解释了铜氧化物超导体过掺杂区的奇异金属输运与光学性质，并引入CDF耗散参数γ的对数增长描述低温行为。
AI.motivation: 铜氧化物超导体中奇异金属相的输运和光学性质缺乏统一理论解释，作者希望利用实验已表征的电荷密度涨落等微观要素，在收缩费米液体框架下建立自洽的物理解释。
AI.method: 基于收缩费米液体理论，将费米子朗道准粒子与低能CDF、声子散射用于解释输运性质；将低能CDF（决定温度依赖）与顺磁子连续谱（决定线性频率散射率）结合解释光学性质；引入CDF耗散参数γ随温度对数增长来描述低温（超导被磁场抑制后）的输运和热力学行为。
AI.result: 理论成功解释了Tc以上奇异金属相的输运和光学性质，实现了ω/T标度行为；在磁场抑制超导后，通过对数增长的γ参数，统一描述了比热、塞贝克系数、热输运、电阻率和磁电阻等所有反常行为。
AI.conclusion: CDF主导的散射机制结合顺磁子连续谱可以构成奇异金属相的自洽图像，为理解铜氧化物超导体中的反常物性提供了统一的理论框架。

title: Magnetic control of Goos-Hänchen shifts and group delay time in monolayer WSe$_2$
summary: We study the influence of an external magnetic field on the Goos-Hänchen (GH) shift and the group delay time (GDT) in monolayer WSe$_2$ in the presence of a magnetic barrier. The transport properties of Dirac-like carriers are obtained by solving the effective low-energy Hamiltonian and evaluating the corresponding transmission amplitudes. The GH shift and the GDT are subsequently extracted from the phase of the transmission coefficient. We systematically analyze their dependence on the magnetic field strength, incident energy, angle of incidence, and barrier width, with particular emphasis on the spin and valley degrees of freedom associated with the $K$ and $K'$ valleys.
